text.en: A rabbit is warm-blooded, covered in fur and feeds its young with milk. Studying its body shows how a typical mammal is organised.

The common rabbit, Oryctolagus cuniculus, is a mammal of phylum Chordata; mammals are warm-blooded, have hair and mammary glands.
Its body has head, neck, trunk and tail; whiskers (vibrissae) are tactile hairs, and the skin has hair, claws and sweat, sebaceous and mammary glands.
A muscular diaphragm separates the thoracic cavity from the abdominal cavity and is a characteristic feature of mammals.
Rabbit teeth are of different kinds, so dentition is heterodont; it has two sets, milk and permanent teeth, so it is diphyodont.
Dental formula: incisors 2/1, canines 0/0, premolars 3/2, molars 3/3 giving 2033/1023; the gap called the diastema replaces the canines.
The caecum is a thin-walled sac with bacteria that digest cellulose.
Respiration is by a pair of lungs; air passes through the nostrils, pharynx, glottis, larynx, trachea, bronchi and bronchioles to the alveoli.
The heart is four chambered with two auricles and two ventricles, with a tricuspid valve on the right and a bicuspid (mitral) valve on the left.
The right auricle receives deoxygenated blood by the precaval and postcaval veins; the left auricle receives oxygenated blood from the lungs; the systemic arch carries blood to the body.
The nervous system has the brain and spinal cord, 12 pairs of cranial nerves and 37 pairs of spinal nerves.
The kidneys remove nitrogenous waste as urea; sexes are separate and sexual dimorphism is exhibited.

problem.en: Find the total number of teeth in the rabbit from its dental formula 2033/1023.

text.en: Teeth on one side of the upper jaw: 2 + 0 + 3 + 3 = 8.
Teeth on one side of the lower jaw: 1 + 0 + 2 + 3 = 6.
One side has 14 teeth, so both sides together have 14 x 2 = 28.

prompt.en: Describe how the blood flows through the four chambers of the rabbit heart.

requiredIdeas.en: Right ventricle sends it to the lungs
Left auricle gets oxygenated blood and the left ventricle sends it to the body

commonMisconceptions.en: Mixing up the left and right sides

points.en: Rabbit: warm-blooded, hair, mammary glands, diaphragm.
Dentition is heterodont and diphyodont; 28 teeth with a diastema.
Four-chambered heart; tricuspid valve on the right, bicuspid on the left.
Caecum digests cellulose with the help of bacteria.
